summary: Piper PA-28R-201 N3509M on an instructional mountain-flying flight from Steamboat Springs to Boulder impacted mountainous terrain ~12 miles southeast of Steamboat Springs near Rabbit Ears Pass (~9,100 ft); instructor William Earl Allen, 62, and student pilot Terry Stewart, 60, were fatally injured. An ALNOT was issued at 1720 when the flight was overdue; search initiated and the wreckage was located at 2146 the same day.
location: near Rabbit Ears Pass, ~12 mi southeast of Steamboat Springs
notes: Fills Routt County's zero-row year 2014 (run 677). NTSB factual report CEN14FA414 parent-opened; responding agency unnamed in report (search initiated via ALNOT). Location coords 40.34111,-106.712776 (Routt side of Rabbit Ears Pass).
